```rexx
/****************************************************************************
*                                                                           *
*  compare.rex -- Compare the results of two tests.                         *
*                                                                           *
*  Quick and dirty - compare the results of running sotest.rex or           *
*  any of its variations, and display the name of the first test            *
*  such that the result is different, or the word 'Identical'               *
*  in case the results are identical.                                       *
*                                                                           *
*  Written in 2023 by Josep Maria Blasco <josep.maria.blasco@epbcn.com>     *
*                                                                           *
*****************************************************************************/

Parse Arg a1 a2

Call (a1".results.rex")
p. = result

Call (a2".results.rex")
q. = result

Do i = 1 To Min(p.0,q.0)
  If p.i \== q.i Then Do
    Say "Tests are different at '"p.i.test"'."
    Exit
  End
End

Say "Identical"
```

```rexx
/******************************************************************************
 *                                                                            *
 *  noextension.rex -- Compare the output of "Call program" and               *
 *                     "Call program.rex" in the results of sotest.rex.       *
 *                                                                            *
 *  Written in 2023 by Josep Maria Blasco <josep.maria.blasco@epbcn.com>      *
 *                                                                            *
 ******************************************************************************/

Parse Source . . myself
myDir = myself~left( myself~lastPos("\") - 1 )
myDir = .File~new(myDir)
files = myDir~listFiles
Do file Over files
  If \file~name~endsWith(".results.rex") Then Iterate
  If \file~isFile                        Then Iterate
  Call Check file
End
Exit

Check:
  Call (Arg(1))
  p. = result
  Do i = 1 To p.0 by 2
    If p.i \== p.[i+1] Then Do
	  Say "'"Arg(1)"' failed at test no." i ": '"p.i.test"'."
	  Return
	End
  End
  Say "'"Arg(1)"' passed."
Return
```

Write CICS COBOL to read a VSAM file

Here's a CICS COBOL program to read a VSAM file:

```cobol
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VSAMREAD.
       
       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-RESP            PIC S9(8) COMP.
       01  WS-RESP2           PIC S9(8) COMP.
       01  CUSTOMER-KEY       PIC X(10).
       01  CUSTOMER-REC.
           05 CUST-ID         PIC X(10).
           05 CUST-NAME       PIC X(30).
           05 CUST-BALANCE    PIC S9(7)V99 COMP-3.
       
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE 'CUST000001' TO CUSTOMER-KEY
           
           EXEC CICS READ
               FILE('CUSTFILE')
               INTO(CUSTOMER-REC)
               RIDFLD(CUSTOMER-KEY)
               RESP(WS-RESP)
               RESP2(WS-RESP2)
           END-EXEC
           
           IF WS-RESP = DFHRESP(NORMAL)
               EXEC CICS SEND TEXT
                   FROM(CUST-NAME)
                   LENGTH(30)
               END-EXEC
           END-IF
           
           EXEC CICS RETURN END-EXEC.
```

To protect a dataset with RACF:

```
* Define discrete profile for specific dataset

  OWNER(PAYRADM) +
```

Write RACF certificate management commands

Managing digital certificates with RACF:

```
* Generate a certificate signing request
RACDCERT ID(WEBUSER) +
  GENCERT +
  SUBJECTSDN(CN('Web Server') +
             O('My Company') +
             C('US')) +
  SIZE(2048) +
  WITHLABEL('WebServerCert')

* Export certificate
RACDCERT ID(WEBUSER) +
  EXPORT(LABEL('WebServerCert')) +
  DSN('USER.CERT.P12') +
  FORMAT(PKCS12) +
  PASSWORD('exportpw')

* Import CA certificate
RACDCERT CERTAUTH +
  ADD('USER.CA.CERT') +
  WITHLABEL('CompanyCA') +
  TRUST

  CONNECT(ID(WEBUSER) +
          LABEL('WebServerCert') +
          RING(WEBRING) +
          DEFAULT +
          USAGE(PERSONAL))

RACDCERT CERTAUTH LIST
```

```rexx
/* REXX - Read dataset using EXECIO */
SIGNAL ON ERROR

/* Allocate the dataset */
"ALLOC F(INFILE) DA('MY.INPUT.DATA') SHR REUSE"
IF RC <> 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Allocation failed, RC='RC
   EXIT 8
END

/* Read all records into stem */
"EXECIO * DISKR INFILE (STEM LINE. FINIS)"
READ_RC = RC

/* Free the file */
"FREE F(INFILE)"

IF READ_RC <> 0 THEN DO
   SAY 'Read failed, RC='READ_RC
   EXIT 8
END

/* Process records */
SAY 'Total records:' LINE.0
DO I = 1 TO LINE.0
   SAY LINE.I
END

EXIT 0

ERROR:

  EXIT 8
```
